findings.title: baseline_evidence_insight_gap
findings.claim: The ayah places clear external evidence and available inward discernment beside a failure of governing commitment.
findings.mechanism: The supplied HFT trace connects the disclosure from settled dwellings with the closing perception state and records a changed reading from missing sight to insight that does not govern movement.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the final description of perception sharpens the account of diversion.
findings.containment: This remains an attributed contextual synthesis from the exact focus trace; it does not invent a lexicon gloss or decide between bodily and inward perception.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus coordinate and root roles are supplied, but the HFT reader identity is legacy_unbound and the trace is broader than the declared pericope.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam şeyin görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The clarity verb carries disclosure emerging from the surviving dwellings.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The dwellings remain as the visible source of evidence, while the closing participle supplies the peoples' available discernment.
branch_activations.activation: Disclosure from the settled remains meets the later inward-sight description, so the record presents evidence and capacity together.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The failure is located in discernment governing conduct rather than in absent evidence.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the form itself means inward insight; that role is supplied by the separate closing perception branch.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Yerleşilip yaşanan ev veya yer, bu eylemin yer adı olarak anlatılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The dwelling noun carries the settled places as concrete sites of habitation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The clarity clause makes those sites disclose evidence, and the closing state supplies the contrast with available perception.
branch_activations.activation: A place built for settled life becomes the medium through which the past is made legible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The dwellings function as evidence that survives the people who occupied them.
branch_activations.boundary: This remains a local evidentiary use of the dwelling image and does not turn every habitation reference into testimony.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, kalpte nüfuz eden kavrayış ve doğrulanmış anlayış çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The closing participle carries a standing capacity for inward discernment.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding clause has already placed clear evidence before the audience.
branch_activations.activation: Available inward understanding meets manifest outward proof, yet the people are still described through diversion.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The contrast becomes a gap between seeing or understanding and letting that understanding govern movement.
branch_activations.boundary: This is an attributed contextual reading of the supplied HFT trace, not a claim that the participle excludes bodily sight.

findings.title: baseline_valuation_capture
findings.claim: The ayah presents diversion as attractive revaluation of purposeful deeds, with agency rerouted toward distance from a recognized way.
findings.mechanism: The supplied HFT trace links beautification, the named adversary, intentional action, transitive obstruction, and the path target in one focus-local sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive an action loop in which people continue acting while the value assigned to their deeds redirects them.
findings.containment: This is an attributed focus-local synthesis; it does not claim that the action noun itself is evil or that the way is destroyed.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus coordinates and branch roles are supplied, but the HFT reader identity is legacy_unbound and the trace is broader than the declared pericope.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey güzelleştirilir veya onda bulunan güzellik eylem ya da söz yoluyla görünür hale getirilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The Form II verb carries active beautification and attractive presentation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The named adversary is the agent and their own deeds are the object.
branch_activations.activation: Beauty is applied to an already purposive field of action, so evaluation itself becomes the point of intervention.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Diversion works through an altered valuation of what they are doing while their agency remains active.
branch_activations.boundary: The form does not say that every beautification is deceptive; the local agent and following consequence establish this bounded case.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ad, türü ne olursa olsun azgın, taşkın ve başkaldıran varlığı belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The named shaytan carries the image of an actively rebellious adversarial agent.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The beautification verb names the operation and the definite path names the course affected.
branch_activations.activation: The named agent is connected to a valuation operation whose result is measured as distance from a recognized route.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The obstruction is mediated by a named adversarial agency rather than presented as an anonymous accident.
branch_activations.boundary: The attribution does not add an unsupplied fire or etymological claim; it stays with the packet's rebellious-agent facet.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The plural object carries their consciously produced work or deeds.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Beautification is applied to this object, and the following verb records its diversionary consequence.
branch_activations.activation: A broad field of intentional action becomes the surface whose appearance is altered.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The danger lies in distorted evaluation of purposeful conduct, while the conduct remains theirs.
branch_activations.boundary: The action noun is not intrinsically evil here; the local beautification and obstruction supply the negative direction.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Geçişli kullanımda özne, başka bir kişiyi belirli bir işten men eder ve yönünü o işten çevirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The completed verb carries transitive turning away or barring of another.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The beautified deeds precede it and the path phrase specifies the direction of the turning.
branch_activations.activation: The attractive presentation issues in an act that redirects the people from a route.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Diversion is the consequence of the valuation capture, not a separate unrelated event.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not erase the people's participation; it describes the supplied transitive obstruction relation.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yol ve bir amaca ulaştıran yol
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanların üzerinde yürüyüp ilerlediği uzanmış yol veya yolları belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The definite singular path carries an extended traversable course.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The obstruction verb and the separation preposition target this recognized route.
branch_activations.activation: The path remains a concrete course against which the diversion can be measured.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people are redirected away from an existing way, so the route itself is not what disappears.
branch_activations.boundary: The local noun remains the recognized way; any broader religious or method sense stays bounded by the supplied facet.

findings.title: baseline_settlement_reversal
findings.claim: The surviving settled places reverse the expected promise of stability and become readable testimony to failed permanence.
findings.mechanism: The supplied HFT trace joins the disclosure verb with two settled-place facets and the closing perception state, changing the dwellings from mere locations into surviving evidence.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see settlement itself turned into the material sign through which the loss is read.
findings.containment: This is an attributed focus-local reversal image; it remains alongside the ordinary dwelling meaning and does not generalize beyond the supplied occurrence.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus coordinate and branch roles are supplied, but the HFT reader identity is legacy_unbound and the trace is broader than the declared pericope.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam şeyin görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The clarity verb carries the former settlement becoming visible and understandable.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The dwelling noun names the settled sites and the closing participle supplies the people described as perceptive.
branch_activations.activation: The sites of settlement disclose what happened to the people who once occupied them.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The places where stability was built become testimony to the failure of that stability.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a local reversal image, not a general claim that every dwelling is a moral witness.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hareketin bitmesiyle şey durur, yerinde kalır veya dingin bir duruma geçer.
branch_activations.carrier: The dwelling noun carries the settled place where movement has come to rest.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The clarity event makes that place legible, while the final participle keeps perceptual capacity in view.
branch_activations.activation: A site that once held settled life survives as a fixed remainder through which the past can be read.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Settlement's stabilizing function is reversed into a visible sign of what did not endure.
branch_activations.boundary: The image stays attached to the supplied dwelling and stillness pressure; it does not replace the ordinary place meaning.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sabit yer ve konum bildiren özel kullanımlar
branch_activations.facet_statement: Çoğul kalıp ifadeler kişilerin yerlerini, konumlarını, düzeylerini, evlerini veya alışılmış düzenlerini gösterebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The plural dwelling form carries the people's places, positions, and homes.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The disclosure clause makes those places readable and the closing insight state sharpens the contrast.
branch_activations.activation: The fixed places remain after their occupants and become the material location of the disclosure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The instruments of settlement survive as evidence against a claim to lasting security.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the packet's place or position facet is used; the special bodily-location and place-name facets remain outside this activation.
